name: Vue
covers: Vue single-file components, with ports of eslint-plugin-vue 10.11.1 rules planned for Rerail.

rules.title: eslint-plugin-vue require-v-for-key: require `v-bind:key` with `v-for` directives
eslint-plugin-vue no-use-v-if-with-v-for: disallow using `v-if` on the same element as `v-for`
eslint-plugin-vue no-duplicate-attributes: disallow duplication of attributes
eslint-plugin-vue no-v-html: disallow use of v-html to prevent XSS attack
eslint-plugin-vue no-child-content: disallow element's child contents which would be overwritten by a directive like `v-html` or `v-text`
eslint-plugin-vue no-deprecated-v-on-native-modifier: disallow using deprecated `.native` modifiers (in Vue.js 3.0.0+)
eslint-plugin-vue valid-v-for: enforce valid `v-for` directives
eslint-plugin-vue no-v-text-v-html-on-component: disallow v-text / v-html on component
eslint-plugin-vue v-on-event-hyphenation: enforce v-on event naming style on custom components in template
eslint-plugin-vue attribute-hyphenation: enforce attribute naming style on custom components in template
eslint-plugin-vue no-dupe-v-else-if: disallow duplicate conditions in `v-if` / `v-else-if` chains
eslint-plugin-vue no-unused-vars: disallow unused variable definitions of v-for directives or scope attributes
eslint-plugin-vue no-template-shadow: disallow variable declarations from shadowing variables declared in the outer scope
eslint-plugin-vue no-unused-refs: disallow unused refs
eslint-plugin-vue no-ref-as-operand: disallow use of value wrapped by `ref()` (Composition API) as an operand
eslint-plugin-vue no-mutating-props: disallow mutation of component props
eslint-plugin-vue no-dupe-keys: disallow duplication of field names
eslint-plugin-vue return-in-computed-property: enforce that a return statement is present in computed property
eslint-plugin-vue no-async-in-computed-properties: disallow asynchronous actions in computed properties
eslint-plugin-vue no-side-effects-in-computed-properties: disallow side effects in computed properties
eslint-plugin-vue no-export-in-script-setup: disallow `export` in `<script setup>`
eslint-plugin-vue no-setup-props-reactivity-loss: disallow usages that lose the reactivity of `props` passed to `setup`
eslint-plugin-vue no-watch-after-await: disallow asynchronously registered `watch`
eslint-plugin-vue require-valid-default-prop: enforce props default values to be valid
